icons.name: emoji-picker
icons.heading: Emoji picker
icons.description: The face reacts: it winks and grins. Light: the head tips toward its right eye, the eye snaps shut and opens again, and the smile widens into a grin a beat later; the head comes back past rest and settles as the grin relaxes. Strong: the head cocks the other way first, then tips further, winks, and breaks into a broad grin that holds, then swings back with two small settling beats. In Solid the wink stays open (a closed slit would close the eye's opening); the grin and the tilt carry it.

icons.name: follow-user
icons.heading: Follow
icons.description: You follow the person: the plus beside them becomes a check and they perk up. Light: the plus twists an eighth of a turn and shrinks away, a check draws in where it was and pops, and the person hops once and lands with a small bounce. Strong: the plus winds back before it twists away, the check snaps in and pops bigger with a settle, and the person hops higher, then once more, smaller. Reverse (unfollow): the check undraws, the plus spins back in with a small pop, and the person sinks a little and recovers.

Strong: the plus winds back before it twists away, the check snaps in and pops bigger with a settle, and the person hops higher, then once more, smaller. Reverse (unfollow): the check undraws, the plus spins back in with a small pop, and the person sinks a little and recovers.

icons.heading: Newspaper

Strong: the paper lifts as the old copy clears, the headline stamps down harder and bounces, the paper takes the knock and rebounds, and the lines write in quicker.

Strong: the shackle swings open wider, slams shut and clicks twice, and the bubble takes two decaying dips. The lock body never moves on the bubble.
